method: Read-only public web retrieval; identity and selected claim checks against source text.

sources.title: When Stale Constraints Go Unchecked: Budgeted Verification Failures in Inherited Agent Memory
verified_claims: The study uses a six-memory scenario with a two-record verification budget.
A forced-critical intervention reallocates a slot within the same budget to the critical provenance path.
The forced policy uses experimenter knowledge and is explicitly not a scheduler.
limits: Supports verification-allocation motivation, not equivalence to BTL's scope swap or proof of BTL novelty.
External study results are not BTL observations; no independent empirical replication was performed.

sources.title: Right Facts, Wrong Rule: Scope-Transfer Poisoning of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
verified_claims: The study examines rule-scope misapplication with factual support and explicit scope boundaries.
For 76.2% of target-matching default responses, the same model judged the rule inapplicable when explicitly probed.
limits: The 76.2% denominator is conditional on target-matching default responses, not all attempts.
Adversarial RAG findings do not establish causal recognition-to-action effects in BTL or prove BTL novelty.

sources.title: Can LLMs Trust Appropriately? Evaluating Calibrated Reliance on Imperfect Partners
verified_claims: The benchmark contains 324 scenarios across 23 collaboration categories with three sequential decisions and analytic evaluation of expected consequences.
The study evaluates seven models alongside 36 controlled-history probes.
Explicit posterior information resolves some errors while introducing others.
limits: The study supports separating evidence sensitivity from appropriate reliance; its counts and outcomes are not BTL data.
No exhaustive comparison or independent replication was performed.

sources.title: AI x Epistemics Research Sprint

limits: Guideline verification does not establish template-content access, template conformity, submission, publication or participation.
